title: Approved privileged group maintenance
objective: Demonstrate a negative control in which authorized administrative activity remains below the unauthorized-change detection contract.
authorization_boundary: Synthetic audit records only. No identity provider, endpoint, or account is contacted.
expected_outcome: Zero detections and zero simulated actions for approved, ticketed administrative changes.

rules.name: Unexpected privileged group membership change
rules.description: A non-approved actor adds an account to a privileged group without a change ticket.

response.description: Recommend preserving the audit record and confirming change authorization before any identity action.
